 This person will work as part an agile team. They will be responsible for development, reporting and analytics. Since this is an agile environment, they will also be responsible for both automation and manual testing, which will occur one day every two weeks.

 Culture is extremely important at Fuse as they are agile and work with team members consistently. This person must be coachable, willing to give feedback, and an extrovert.
